context: The .gitignore contents are supplied inline in the input; there is no external data source. Evaluate each repository-relative candidate path against only the supported .gitignore subset: exact file/path patterns, * wildcards (which may match / characters), directory patterns ending in / (matching the exact directory candidate and any path beginning with that directory/), and negation patterns starting with !. Blank lines, lines beginning with #, and a lone ! are ignored and receive no rule number. Each line is stripped of surrounding whitespace before parsing. Number supported patterns from 1 in top-to-bottom order. For every candidate path, the last matching supported pattern wins: a normal match means ignored, a ! match means included. If no supported pattern matches, report included with null winning_rule and winning_pattern. Output one decision per candidate path, in the input order, with the original path, the final status, the one-based pattern-only rule number, and the exact winning pattern including any leading !.
